# Pinned transport sources

BRSP/1 files copied byte-for-byte from the installed
`browser-remote-sync-protocol` skill source. Upstream:
<https://github.com/GeorgeFejer91/browser-remote-sync-protocol>.
The installed directory has no Git metadata; these hashes identify the exact
copied bytes without claiming an unverified upstream commit.

BRSP is MIT; the local app-profile/native integration is separately authored.
The VDO.Ninja SDK is MPL-2.0. Exact release/file hashes and corresponding readable
source are retained in [its notice](vdoninja/1.5.5/NOTICE.md). All source and
license files must remain available alongside any distribution. No RustDesk
source or generic remote-desktop input implementation is included.
